title: The Best Place to Manage & Grow Your Money | Ben Shen, Head of Financial Services & Loyalty Products
description:
Coinbase is building financial services of the future. The traditional financial system limits your money and your ability to grow it. Ben Shen shares how crypto unlocks it. 

__

At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #bitcoin #blockchain

asr.full_text: Thank you, Max. CoinBase is becoming the place where customers are managing their entire financial lives. Whether it's getting a credit card, a loan or sending money to friends and family we want CoinBase to be the best place to manage and grow your money with opportunities that traditional banks simply do not offer. Let me show you how this works starting where much of our money often begins – our paycheque. We are going to start by giving people that traditional banks simply do not offer. Let me show you how this works, starting where much of our money often begins, our paycheck. We are letting you get paid directly into Coinbase while automatically investing and earning. You can set up direct deposit, allocate your paychecks across crypto of your choice and cash, growing your money exactly the way you want each time you get paid. This will naturally extend to stocks and other assets on the Everything Exchange. Once your direct deposit hits, your cash immediately starts compounding. You can earn 3.5 % in USDC rewards, with weekly payouts for a Coinbase One membership. That's nearly 9 times the national average savings rate. And for those who want to supercharge their earnings, you can lend your USDC on Coinbase. Banks are constantly lending out your money while maintaining profit. On Coinbase, the power shifts back to you. You control when to lend, access your money whenever you want, and keep the rewards. This entire system, powered by crypto, offers superior returns and flexibility. Our customers have already lent over $1 billion since we launched just three months ago, earning up to 10% in rewards on their USDC. Customers are also staking assets like Ethereum, Solana and more, to maximize their long-term growth. And they've earned over $1 billion in staking rewards since 2023. And for the first time ever, you can now instantly unstable stake your assets on Coinbase. Meaning you can earn with confidence on your crypto knowing you can get instant liquidity at any time, whether for trading, or any other case. This is true wealth building with with rates and liquidity that traditional financial institutions simply cannot match. Retail customers are voting with their assets. As of the third quarter, they held over $200 billion in assets on Coinbase, more than tripling since 2023. Sometimes life can bring unexpected expenses or require large purchases, such as a down paymentment on a home. Coinbase makes managing these expenses easier than ever with our borrowed product. You can instantly access cash without selling the assets that you truly believe in. And since January, our customers have already accessed $1.5 billion in liquidity at rates which are lower than most traditional bank loans and with more immediate accessibility. You can borrow up the $5 million against your Bitcoin. And we just launched the ability to borrow up to $1 million against your Ethereum. Plus, we're planning to act expand many other assets that you can trade on the Everything Exchange. Now let me show you how easy it is actually use your money on Coinbase. With our new dedicated pay tab you can send us UTC or any other crypto asset like Bitcoin to anyone in the world instantly for free. By simply using a phone number, email or wallet address. We are seeing our customers paying friends back, making purchases and gifting crypto, including to those who don't even own crypto or don't have a Coinbase account and who can easily sign up to claim their payments. Even better, our customers are now earning up to four percent in Bitcoin on their everyday purchases! We launched CBC1 3 months ago and our customers are absolutely loving it, earning over $16 million in Bitcoin during that time! The truth is, most credit card rewards are often limited to a few categories or lose value over time. With the Coinbase OneCard, you don't have to worry about points, categories or blackout dates. We give you bitcoin, the most rewarding and flexible asset on the planet! And you can do whatever you want with it… hold it, send it, spend it or sell it! To make things even more exciting, you get chances to win up to 100,000 dollars in BTC each month by simply taking out your Coinbase ONE card and spending with it. With zero trading fees, boosted earnings, and more ways to build your wealth coming next year, Coinbase ONE is the, boosted earnings, and more ways to build your wealth coming next year, Coinbase One is the best membership for growing your money. At Coinbase, we're not just building the best trading platform. We're building the Primary Financial Account of the future. The traditional financial system limits your money. Crypto unlocks it. And now,

evidence.quote: You can set up direct deposit, allocate your paychecks across crypto of your choice and cash, growing your money exactly the way you want each time you get paid.
You can earn 3.5 % in USDC rewards, with weekly payouts for a Coinbase One membership.

textual.context: Promotional product description attributed to a Coinbase speaker; the records do not establish whether the stated reward is currently available to all viewers or whether the claim is independently verified.
textual.potential_relevance: The requested direct-deposit and membership actions are explicitly linked to a stated recurring crypto-denominated reward.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual returns, eligibility, fees, account terms, or whether deposited funds are protected or recoverable.

textual.observation: Coinbase promotes lending USDC on its platform as a way to earn up to 10% in rewards, while describing customer control over lending and access to funds.

evidence.quote: you can lend your USDC on Coinbase.
earning up to 10% in rewards on their USDC.

textual.potential_relevance: A requested transfer or deployment of USDC into a lending product is linked to a stated return of up to 10%.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the applicable term, risks, eligibility, fees, principal protection, or whether the stated maximum return is typical.

textual.observation: Coinbase promotes borrowing cash against Bitcoin or Ethereum holdings, including stated borrowing limits of up to $5 million against Bitcoin and up to $1 million against Ethereum.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish eligibility, collateral requirements, interest rates, liquidation conditions, fees, or repayment outcomes.

visual.observation: A presentation slide states "You can also borrow against your assets on Coinbase" beside a phone mockup showing a "Borrow USDC" interface with "1,000 USD" and collateral-related fields.
visual.context: Product-presentation context; the visible slide frames borrowing as an available Coinbase feature, not as a warning or report.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible relationship is an offer to receive borrowed USD/USDC through an app flow linked to using assets as collateral, which conditionally merits review as an asset-backed financial action rather than because cryptocurrency appears alone.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not establish whether any viewer is instructed to click, apply, transfer assets, accept loan terms, or whether the borrowing feature was actually used.

The speaker links some benefits to membership, lending, or card spending, and an informational disclaimer qualifies the presentation as general product-related communication. the available video evidence does not establish deceptive conduct or an unsupported transaction outcome.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The main content presents Coinbase financial services and their use: paycheck allocation, lending USDC and borrowing against Bitcoin. Card rewards are another product feature, but rewards alone are not the presentation's central context.
